newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel - low sulphur more active.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel - low sulphur more active.

text.p: After a particuarly quiet period the low sulphur straight-run market kicked into gear ahead of the holiday break.

One 28,000 tonne Irish cargo was sold at $140.25 fob NWE while a Scandinavian 0.4 percent sulphur handysize parcel went into Sweden at $160 cif. A cargo of Tunisian material that was competing with the Irish piece may now be taken transatlantic.
Russian M-40 was heard offerd as high as two means +$5, but most traders said +$2 was a more realistic level. A reoffered E-4 was heard talked at formula +$3.
